symbols.name: ScalarPropertyBagJson
symbols.summary: Parses a plain JSON object into a case-insensitive bag of scalar values.

symbols.name: Parse(string, bool)
symbols.summary: Reads JSON strings, Boolean values, nulls, and numbers into a new property bag.
symbols.remarks: Numbers use System.Int64 when possible, then System.Decimal if its conversion to System.Double agrees with the parsed double, and otherwise a finite System.Double. Nonzero numbers that round to zero as a double are rejected. Case-insensitive duplicate keys keep the first spelling and last value.

syntax.content: public static Result Parse(string json, bool preserveMissing = false)

parameters.description: A JSON object, a JSON null, or omitted text.
Return a null bag for omitted, blank, or JSON null input when true. Otherwise return an empty bag. An explicit empty object always returns an empty bag.

returns.description: The parsed bag or the requested missing value on success. A BridgingIT.DevKit.Common.ValidationError reports JSON syntax errors, non-object roots other than null, blank property names, nested values, or numbers outside the supported range.
